Research and Development (R&D) encompasses a wide range of roles focused on the innovation, development, and enhancement of products, technologies, and processes. Professionals in this field work to transform scientific knowledge into practical applications, ensuring that the organization's offerings are at the forefront of the industry. This job family is essential for driving growth, maintaining competitiveness, and addressing emerging market needs.
Job purpose
Reporting to the President & Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and the Global Head of R&D, the Head of Research & Development (R&D) will play a lead role in delivering business critical R&D programmes. The Head of R&D is a member of the Molecular Imaging Senior Leadership Team and will have management responsibility for the following functions: Biometrics; Chemistry, Manufacturing & Control (CMC); Clinical Operations; Editorial (Medical Writing); Imaging; Non-Clinical; R&D Programme Management
Main Responsibilities, Activities, Duties and Tasks
• Biometrics (to include biostatistics, statistical programming, and data management), ensuring operational delivery and the provision of strategic advice concerning statistical methods and data management activities.
• Chemistry, Manufacturing & Control (CMC) ensuring the robust manufacturing and supply of materials used in the manufacture of investigational and finished commercial radiopharmaceutical products.
• Clinical operations, ensuring operational delivery and the provision of strategic advice concerning the design, feasibility and execution of all clinical studies.
• Editorial (medical writing), ensuring the development and implementation of strategic publication plans and the dissemination of scientific and clinical data (e.g., via manuscripts and conference presentations).
• Imaging, providing medical physics support, including radiation physics, medical imaging physics and imaging analytics expertise.
• Non-clinical, to include evaluations of non-clinical toxicology, safety and efficacy.
• R&D programme management, including:
• Delivery of the programme strategy (in accordance with the Long-Range Plan and in close collaboration with colleagues in Clinical Development, Commercial, Finance, Innovation & Strategy, Legal (incl. Intellectual Property), Medical Affairs, Pharmacovigilance & Quality and Regulatory Affairs).
• Operational oversight and project delivery, in compliance with applicable laws, industry codes and regulations
• Budget management (including Long-Range Planning, Annual Budget and Rolling Forecast 2 & 3 and related resource allocation & planning),
• Portfolio review,
• Risk management,
• Regular reporting to the Executive Committee and Board of Directors including progress in achieving strategic objectives; advising of any significant variance from the approved strategic plans and budget; and any significant programme issues.
• Research and Development
• Collaborating with the New Asset Evaluation Team, specifically on the identification and technical assessment of new licensing, lifecycle and geographic expansion opportunities.
• Collaborations with academia, pharma and imaging equipment providers
• All matters of significant organisational structure within R&D, including development of the capabilities of the internal workforce and the recruitment, promotion, retention, succession planning & dismissal of employees, in conjunction with Human Resources.
• Establish or implement departmental policies, goals, objectives, or procedures in conjunction with the Leadership Team and Global R&D at Bracco.
• Other duties as determined by business needs
Education/Qualifications
• Educated to at least degree level, preferably with a PhD in science or life science (or
• equivalent research experience)
Professional Experience, Knowledge, & Technical Skills
• Significant experience in clinical drug development and particularly the development of medical imaging agents and radiopharmaceuticals is key, as is significant experience of staff & performance management.
• A strong scientific background in a relevant area in a relevant scientific discipline an advantage and awareness of relevant guidelines and regulations governing drug development activities, particularly imaging drugs, a pre-requisite.
• Knowledge of Regulatory Authority (i.e., EMA, FDA) and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.
• Proven  leadership,  organisational,  facilitation,  negotiation,  collaboration, empowerment, and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with others at all levels of the organisation.
• Experience with cross-functional and highly matrixed organizations.
• Ability to coach, mentor, develop and educate direct reports.
• Excellent written and verbal communication
Soft Skills – Company Values & Behaviours
• Excellent interpersonal skills, including communication verbally and in writing. Ability to influence and build relationships in a global organisation
• Excellent organisational skills, including multitasking, efficiency, punctuality, and project management
• Excellent collaboration skills including experience in a cross-functional and highly matrixed organisation.
Contract type:
Permanent

Job Description
COSTAR GROUP – INSIDE SALES ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE (ITALIAN SPEAKING), MATTERPORT - LONDON
OVERVIEW
CoStar Group is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives.
We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers.  We’ve continually refined, transformed, and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors.  We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation.  This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors.  By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.
ABOUT MATTERPORT
Matterport, part of the CoStar Group, is leading the digital transformation of the built world. Our ground-breaking spatial computing platform turns buildings into data making every space more valuable and accessible. Millions of buildings in more than 177 countries have been transformed into immersive Matterport digital twins to improve every part of the building lifecycle from planning, construction, and operations to documentation, appraisal, and marketing.
Learn more about Matterport.
DESCRIPTION
As an Inside Sales Account Executive at Matterport, you will be part of a fast-growing, high-velocity sales organization responsible for helping customers across industries digitize their buildings, streamline operations, and unlock measurable business value through Matterport’s leading 3D digital twin platform.
You will run a full-cycle sales motion—prospecting, discovery, demos, pricing, negotiation, and closing—in a high-activity environment where speed, precision, and strong communication are critical. You’ll speak daily with customers in industries such as Architecture, Engineering & Construction, Facilities Management, Corporate Real Estate, Industrial/Manufacturing, Retail, Hospitality, and Insurance/Restoration.
This is a role for someone who is passionate, solutions focused and skilled at turning conversations into revenue. You’ll work closely with Sales Enablement and your Regional Director to master Matterport’s sales frameworks, sharpen your outbound skills, deliver strong discovery, and run efficient, consultative sales cycles. As one of the first hires in our expanding Inside Sales organization, you’ll help shape the culture, standards, and execution rhythms of a team built to scale. Your mission: create pipeline, convert conversations, close business, and help customers experience the impact of digitizing the built world - fast.
This role is on-site five days a week in Southwark, London
RESPONSIBILITIES
• Run a full cycle inside sales process, including prospecting, discovery, demos, pricing, negotiation, and closing.
• Generate your own pipeline, using outbound calls, emails, sequences, and follow-up to reach decision-makers.
• Drive new customer acquisition through a mix of inbound follow-up and outbound prospecting.
• Manage a fast-paced pipeline, balancing new opportunities daily while keeping active deals moving efficiently.
• Conduct high-quality discovery calls, uncovering customer pain points, workflows, and use cases that demonstrate the value of Matterport’s platform.
• Deliver polished product demonstrations that map customer needs to Matterport’s capabilities and ROI drivers.
• Follow structured sales frameworks to deliver clear, disciplined, high-impact conversations.
• Collaborate with your Regional Director and Sales Enablement for coaching, call reviews, skill development, and rapid improvement.
• Maintain CRM accuracy - updating activities, opportunities, next steps, and forecasting data with precision.
• Partner with cross-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Support) to deliver exceptional customer experience and accelerate deals.
• Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets while maintaining high activity and strong conversion rates.
• Represent Matterport with professionalism, continuously reinforcing our values and delivering customer-first engagement.
QUALIFICATIONS
• Demonstrable B2B sales experience, ideally in inside sales, SaaS, or a high-velocity sales environment.
• Demonstrated success in roles requiring high outbound activity, pipeline generation, and consistent quota attainment.
• Strong communication and presentation skills - confident on the phone, on Teams/Zoom, and in demos.
• Experience running short sales cycles, balancing multiple deals, and driving urgency with clarity.
• Highly coachable with a strong desire to improve quickly and master modern sales skills.
• Strong organizational discipline - accurate forecasting, CRM management, and time prioritization.
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
• A track record of commitment to prior employers.
• Operates with high degree of integrity.
• Some travel to deepen customer relationships and execute a high-touch sales strategy.
PREFERRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience selling SaaS or technology solutions to AEC, Facilities Management, CRE, Industrial/Manufacturing, Insurance/Restoration, Retail, or related industries.
• English and Italian fluency is essential.
• Proven ability to build pipeline independently through outbound efforts.
• Experience with Salesforce.com, Gong, Clari, or similar sales tools.
• Strong storytelling and value articulation skills - able to explain complex ideas simply.
• A high-energy, positive presence that contributes to a competitive, supportive team environment.
• Passion for learning and mastering new technologies and sales frameworks.
• Comfort operating in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
Working at CoStar Group means you'll enjoy a culture of collaboration and innovation that attracts the best and brightest across a broad range of disciplines. As well as having an outstanding working environment, equipped to help you to be your best, other perks include full private medical cover, dental cover, Life Assurance and member rewards, 28 days annual leave, a competitive pension, season ticket loans, enhanced maternity and paternity pay and much more!
At CoStar, we recognize the positive value of diversity and promote equality. We aim at all times to recruit the person who is most suited to the job and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds including but not limited to; people of all genders, of all ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, nationalities, religions and beliefs.

Company Description
Depop is a peer-to-peer circular fashion marketplace where anyone can buy, sell and discover secondhand fashion. Our mission is simple: to make fashion circular by making secondhand as exciting and rewarding as buying new.
Founded in 2011, Depop’s diverse community has helped move resale into the mainstream, where buying secondhand is no longer an alternative, but how people of different ages now engage with fashion. Today, more than 56 million registered users come to Depop to find great value, express their own personal style and give clothes a longer life. We believe that everything you want already exists, and our role is to help people discover it.
Powered by a team of over 500 people, our company is headquartered in London, with offices in New York. In 2021, Depop became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Etsy - the global marketplace for unique and creative goods - and continues to operate as a standalone company. For more information, visit www.depop.com
We aim to create an inclusive environment where everyone is welcome, no matter who they are or where they’re from. Just as our platform connects people globally, we believe our workplace should reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. We thrive on the power of different perspectives and experiences, knowing they drive innovation and bring us closer to our users.
We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, providing employment opportunities without regard to age, ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy or maternity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other protected status. We’re continuously evolving our recruitment processes to ensure fairness and are open to accommodating any needs you might have.
AI Disclosure: We use AI tools (Google Gemini) to help our team source and review applications for roles with a high volume of applications. These tools assist our recruiters in identifying great talent but do not replace human decision-making. At Depop, every hiring decision is made by a human.
If, due to a disability, you need adjustments to complete the application, please let us know by sending an email with your name, the role to which you would like to apply, and the type of support you need to complete the application to adjustments@depop.com.
Role
Depop is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Scientist to join our Pricing team in the UK. You will work alongside a cross-functional team of Product Managers, Engineers, Analysts and fellow Machine Learning Scientists, playing a key role in building the machine learning models that power Depop’s pricing recommendations and our shipping pricing and optimisation strategies.
As a senior member of the team, you will be expected to take ownership of high-impact projects, lead technical direction on core modelling efforts, and mentor others while working across multiple domains and stakeholders.
Responsibilities
You will:
• Research, design, and deliver robust machine learning solutions to tackle problems across the pricing and shipping space, spanning both prediction and decision-making under business constraints
• Lead efforts to productionise and scale these models, partnering with ML and backend engineers so they run reliably on our systems
• Identify and define requirements from multiple stakeholders across Pricing and Shipping, and lead the design of machine learning solutions to solve applied business problems
• Set up and conduct large-scale experiments to test hypotheses and guide model and product improvements, ensuring statistical rigour and real-world applicability
• Keep up to date with applied research, contribute to internal knowledge sharing and ML best practices, and apply new techniques for prediction, causal inference, and optimisation
• Participate in team ceremonies, such as technical whiteboarding sessions, planning, and roadmapping
• Communicate technical findings clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences
Qualifications
Skills and Experience
• Significant experience working as a Machine Learning Scientist, with a proven track record of delivering and scaling models that solve complex, real-world problems
• Deep understanding of machine learning concepts and experience applying them in production settings, using frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or gradient boosting libraries
• Experience with causal inference, uplift modelling, or optimisation under constraints, and comfort reasoning about decisions rather than predictions alone
• Strong Python skills, with the ability to write clean, modular, production-grade code, and a solid understanding of data engineering and MLOps principles
• Ability to lead end-to-end ML projects, work independently in ambiguous problem spaces, and mentor junior team members
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience aligning technical approaches with cross-functional teams and stakeholders
Bonus Points
• Experience with pricing models, promotions or incentive allocation, or revenue optimisation
• Experience with experiment design and conducting A/B tests
• Experience with bandits, reinforcement learning, or other explore-exploit approaches
• Experience with Databricks and PySpark
• Experience working with AWS or another cloud platform (GCP/Azure)
Additional Information
Health + Mental Wellbeing

• Subsidised counselling and coaching with Self Space
• Cycle to Work scheme with options from Evans or the Green Commute Initiative
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for 24/7 confidential support
• Mental Health First Aiders across the business for support and signposting
Work/Life Balance:
• 25 days of annual leave with the option to carry over up to 5 days
• Impact hours: Up to 2 days of additional paid leave per year for volunteering
• Fully paid 4-week sabbatical after completion of 5 years of consecutive service with Depop, to give you a chance to recharge or do something you love.
• Flexible Working: MyMode hybrid-working model with Flex, Office-Based, and Remote options *role-dependent
• All offices are dog-friendly
Family Life:
• For birth parent: 20 weeks of paid parental leave for full-time regular employees
• For non-birth parents: 12 weeks of paid parental leave for full-time regular employees
• IVF leave, shared parental leave, and paid emergency parent/carer leave
Learn + Grow:
• Twice-yearly development chats and yearly performance reviews
• Learning budget
• Upskilling our employees with company-wide training workshops, materials and resources
Your Future:

• Pension matching up to 6% of full base salary with Aviva

Your impact
Join Leonardo UK as Domain Architect – Digital Backbone and Digital Employee Experience and take ownership of the target architecture, long-term roadmap and investment story for the platforms every person, product and programme in the business depends on.
Two connected domains sit behind everything we do. The Digital Backbone covers the compute, storage, network, datacentre, cloud and platform engineering estate that our business-critical services run on. Digital Employee Experience covers the workplace, collaboration, identity and device estate our people use every day. Both domains are being modernised at pace, and both require clear architectural direction, credible investment planning and disciplined assurance.
This is a Strategy-to-Portfolio architecture role. It is not primarily a project delivery post: the successful candidate will set the direction that delivery teams work towards, assure that what is built reflects what was designed, agreed and funded, and help shape the investment choices that determine Leonardo UK’s future technology foundation.
You will work closely with the Head of Enterprise Architecture UK, the Digital Solutions CTO UK and CTO Italy, fellow Enterprise and Domain Architects, Security Architects, Solution Architects, service owners and technology governance bodies, including the Global Architecture Board. You will be recognised as an authority on the current estate, its direction of travel and the architectural decisions required to make it secure, resilient, affordable and scalable.
We believe high-impact architecture is driven by outcomes. This role operates on a flexible hybrid working model, with purposeful travel to site for design workshops, architecture boards and key stakeholder sessions.
This role reports to the Head of Enterprise Architecture UK.
In this role you will:
Own the target state for both domains, convert it into a funded and sequenced multi-year roadmap, assure delivery against it, and raise the standard of architecture practice across the community that builds it.
Domain architecture and target state
•

Maintain an accurate baseline of the current estate, working with domain and service owners so landscape models reflect reality.

Translate those signals into a concise, defensible set of domain drivers that underpin the roadmap and investment plan.
•
Assess emerging technology on evidence rather than hype, using proportionate proof-of-value activity and clear adopt, trial, watch or avoid recommendations.
•
Maintain awareness of relevant vendor, open-source and industry direction, incorporating it into domain standards and roadmaps where it earns its place.
Roadmaps and long-term planning
•
Own and maintain a rolling three-year domain roadmap with a five-year technology outlook, refreshed on a predictable cycle.
•
Sequence change around the constraints that genuinely matter: hardware and operating system lifecycle, licence and contract renewals, datacentre and cloud commitments, and the rate of change the business can absorb.
•
Model options and trade-offs — buy or build, cloud or on-premises, refresh or replace — making cost, risk and capability impact explicit.
•
Plan headroom for growth so capacity, licensing and footprint decisions do not become tomorrow’s constraint.
•
Maintain a single published view of obsolescence and technical debt, with the cost of inaction quantified.
Investment planning
•
Convert roadmap increments into investment items with indicative cost, benefit, dependency and delivery-confidence ranges.
•
Provide the architecture content for business cases, stage gates and portfolio submissions.
•
Work with Finance, Portfolio and Service Owners on affordability, phasing and the run-cost consequences of design choices.
•
Advise on prioritisation where demand exceeds available funding, and trace approved investment back to the roadmap, so plan and architecture do not drift apart.
Architecture assurance and governance
•
Act as a standing member of the design authority for both domains, reviewing and approving high-level designs, patterns and deviations.
•
Provide the architecture opinion at portfolio and delivery gates, confirming alignment to target state, secure-by-design principles, supportability and affordability.
•
Own the reference patterns, standards and guardrails that architects reuse, keeping them current and making the compliant path the easy path.
•
Operate a transparent dispensation process where exceptions are time-bound, owned, costed and logged as debt rather than quietly absorbed.

Job Title
Marketing Manager - Media and Campaigns
Job Description
So, who are we?
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
Your Team:
This role sits within the UK Brand Marketing team, reporting into the Senior Marketing Manager. The team is responsible for IG’s brand identity, major campaigns, and media strategy across the UK, working closely with in-house Studio, external creative agencies, and a media agency on day-to-day delivery.
There are no direct reports in this role; your impact comes through the breadth of your campaign management, the depth of your media expertise, the initiatives you drive in your market and other regions, and the relationships you build across the business.
Your role in the Team’s Success:
IG is looking for a Marketing Manager to join our Brand Marketing team, owning campaign delivery across the full marketing mix, with media as your core area of depth. You’ll take end-to-end ownership of a market outside the UK (currently this is Ireland) – from strategy through to execution – and flex to support campaign delivery and testing in other non-UK regions as priorities require.
This is a broad, hands-on marketing management role. You’ll need to be commercially fluent across the full campaign mix – while bringing genuine depth in paid media planning, which will be your lead area of specialism within the team. If you’re a well-rounded marketing manager with strong media expertise, comfortable owning a market independently, and energised by variety, this is a strong next step.
What you’ll do:
Media management
• You’ll own campaign delivery end-to-end across the full marketing mix, with media as your area of deepest specialism – making sure every channel is working together toward the same brief, and that our media agency is held to the sharpest scrutiny.
Marketing mix literacy
• Understand how each channel contributes to campaign performance, and make trade-off calls across channels – not just within media – as plans develop.
Media strategy, planning & agency management
• As your area of deepest expertise, own the briefing and interrogation of media plans across ATL and TTL channels, and know how to get the best out of our media agency, driving forward performance, effectiveness and efficiencies.
Media mix modelling & full-funnel optimisation
• Work with MMM and econometric outputs to identify what’s actually driving performance, balancing brand-building activity with lower-funnel media, and translating findings into changes in future plans.
Cross-functional coordination
• Act as the connective layer across Brand, Performance, Social & Content, PR and CRM, so that campaigns land as one joined-up plan.
Reporting, measurement & test-and-learn
• Contribute to campaign reporting with clear, actionable insight across the full mix, and keep a live view of new formats and channel innovation to build a case for testing where it could improve performance or efficiency.
Campaign management
• You’ll bring strong all-round campaign marketing management skills, applying them across UK and international activity – including ownership of a defined market outside the UK (currently Ireland), with scope to extend support into other regions as needed.
• Plan, adapt and deliver marketing campaigns end-to-end, tailoring messaging, assets and channel approach to different audiences, markets and objectives.
• Own end-to-end marketing activity for a defined market outside the UK (currently Ireland), developing and delivering plans that are tailored to local needs while remaining consistent with IG’s overall brand positioning.
• Adapt UK campaign assets and messaging for other markets as needed, ensuring relevance and compliance with local regulatory requirements.
• Stay close to the competitive and regulatory landscape across the markets you support, identifying opportunities to strengthen IG’s brand presence.
• Extend campaign support to other non-UK regions as required, including adapting assets, briefing local partners, and running test-and-learn activity.
• Share learnings across markets and campaigns, feeding insight back into broader planning.
Team collaboration
• Stay closely aligned to the wider Brand and Marketing team’s priorities, flexing capacity to support high-priority projects where needed and ensuring activity is sequenced and joined up with the broader team agenda.
What Success Looks Like - In the first six months, we’d expect you to:
• Be a trusted, credible voice with our media agency – someone whose challenge on a plan or RTB is taken seriously because it’s well-reasoned and grounded in the brief.
• Be seen as a well-rounded campaign owner – as comfortable in creative and content conversations as you are holding the media agency to account.
• Be contributing insight that visibly changes how we plan – not just reporting on what happened, but shaping what happens next.
What You'll Need:
• 6+ years’ experience in brand or integrated marketing role, ideally within a fast-paced commercial environment.
• Proven experience supporting or delivering campaigns end-to-end, with solid paid media management experience, including agency management.
• Experience of working in the Financial Services or Fintech sector.
• Commercially minded, with the ability to identify opportunities that drive brand and business performance.
• Experience managing or contributing to multi-channel marketing activity across paid, owned, and earned channels.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, with strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
• Comfortable working with data and insight to evaluate campaign performance and inform decisions.
• Strong communicator with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and with external agency partners.
Desirable
• Experience managing marketing activity or providing campaign support in an international market.
• Familiarity with regulatory requirements for financial services marketing.
• Understanding of, or experience in, investing, trading, cryptocurrency, or fintech.
The Perks
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs,…

Gather customer intelligence and feedback to support proactive participation in product enhancement and new product development.

Ensure accurate management of CRM records (SFDC) within the territory
•
Ensure that product knowledge and customer communication are maintained to the highest standard.

Provide product samples and quotations to customers in a timely manner.

•
Degree or equivalent experience in a life sciences discipline, such as molecular biology, microbiology, biological sciences, biochemistry, medical science or a related field.

Proven field sales experience – 2 years minimum – within the UK life sciences market, ideally with laboratory consumables, instrumentation and/or sample management solutions.

Ability to demonstrate technical products and clearly explain sample management workflows, customer value and application benefits.

Commercially focused and target-driven, with strong territory planning, pipeline management, account development and customer relationship skills.

Good awareness of the UK laboratory and life sciences marketplace, including customer needs, market trends and competitor activity.

Self-motivated, organised and confident working independently across a defined territory while contributing effectively as part of a wider sales team.

Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel regularly across Oxford, Wales and the South West UK.

•
Become part of a company that makes a positive contribution to launching groundbreaking scientific developments and therapies.

Contribute to innovative cell therapies and be part of revolutionary cancer therapies.

Job Description:

Luton is the home to around 1,000 people who are involved in the design and development of Leonardo’s Electronic Warfare (EW) capability, which is used to protect airborne platforms from a range of RF-based threats.  This includes:

Role description
As an Industrial Placement Systems Engineer you will work alongside some of the most talented engineers in the UK. You will support the development of world-leading technologies and capabilities across multiple Avionic Systems and Platforms.
Industrial Placement Systems Engineers have the opportunity to be involved in different phases of the systems engineering lifecycle to create and deliver new and emerging capabilities required by our customers; from understanding the customer’s requirements, developing system architectures and concept designs for the next generation of EW capability, through to integration and testing of equipment and systems.
Key Responsibility Areas
Working as part of an established systems engineering community and supported by a team of experienced engineers, you will be responsible for:
• Developing practical skills in engineering design and development for complex systems, understanding key processes and technologies.
• Gaining an understanding of the EW domain to support the development of relevant products and technologies.
• Working closely with engineers across multiple disciplines to solve problems.
• Completing tasks to a high standard in accordance with appropriate processes and procedures.
• Developing and applying your academic skills to solve problems, generate ideas and be proactive within the team.
What we need from you:
Qualifications
All of our Industrial Placement roles require you to be currently studying for a degree in a relevant discipline.
For the Industrial Placement Systems Engineer role, the acceptable degrees are: aerospace/aeronautical engineering, computer science/systems, electrical/electronic engineering, general engineering, mathematics, mechanical engineering, physics, and systems engineering.
You must have an understanding of mathematics to at least A-Level standard, and a basic understanding of electronics.
You should also ideally have experience of working with engineering development tools (e.g. MATLAB, Simulink, Rhapsody, Cameo, DOORS).
Security Clearance
Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations.  As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years.
For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV).  As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.
To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years.  In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.  Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.

Ordnance Survey is one of the Britain’s most impactful technology and data companies.  We’re part of everyday life, with our data being used up to 40 times by the average person. We operate an invisible layer that enables the digital world to understand the physical world.
Geovation exists to expand this impact further, we want to push the boundaries of what is possible with location data.  We’re passionate about bringing entrepreneurs, innovators and geospatial experts together to solve real world problems in new ways.
Our Farringdon hub is a vibrant space where first-time founders collaborate with experienced entrepreneurs and geospatial specialists. It’s a place where ideas become reality. We host events, encourage creativity, and help build the next generation of data-driven applications.
Our incubation team builds and experiments directly with start-ups, helping them turn their ideas into products and building viable businesses around them.
About the Role:
As the Incubator Manager at Geovation you’re responsible for making sure the startups we take into our programme can use it as a launch pad for their ambitions. You’ll play a leading role in finding and selecting which startups we support, and it will be up to you to develop bespoke support programmes that enable them to build sustainable businesses around the products that the technical part of the team helps to build.
You will work closely with the Incubator Lead and our technical and ecosystem teams along with third parties and OS experts to deliver this support.  You’ll also have a role in the wider community – as one of the key people in the team who really ‘gets founders’ and know what they need. You will build strong relationships with founders and understand the challenges facing their business, but you will also be responsible for making sure the detail behind the programme works.
We’re looking for someone who thrives on building relationships, influencing others and making things happen. You’ll take the lead on some of our key strategic partnerships, building strong relationships across Geovation, Ordnance Survey and our external network.
You’ll need to be confident working with senior stakeholders, balancing different priorities and bringing people together around shared goals. Leadership experience would be an advantage, particularly as you’ll help shape direction and support others to succeed.

• Scout for startups to invite to apply to the programme in response to target areas set by the Team Leads, manage the recruitment and selection process and facilitate the administrative sides of the process, including appropriate due diligence and finance.
• Be the main point of contact for startups within the programme. Work with the Incubator Lead to design support on a startup-by-startup basis to ensure support aligns with the wider strategy of the team.
• Lead on the design and delivery of non-technical support jointly with the Ecosystem team, utilising programme alumni, Geovation, OS employees and third parties.
• Be an advocate for the power of location data, the impact that startups have on creating new markets and industries for OS data and advocate for the specific startups we support.
• Look for connections between different founder needs, OS capabilities, market opportunities and activity happening across the wider Geovation ecosystem.
• Be a key part of making the Geovation Hub is a vibrant creative place to work and a safe, inclusive, welcoming, and well-maintained space for members and visitors.  This includes involvement in events and activation as well as some formal Fire, health & safety responsibilities for the Geovation Hub and ad-hoc tasks required as part of a small team running a busy coworking space.

About you and how we work
We’re looking for someone who is passionate about startups and knows what they need, ideally you will have worked in or with start-ups in the past and can bring that experience to bear.
We want someone who’s comfortable tailoring the message for the diverse audiences we work with, helping communicate the value of our community that we’ve created over the last 15 years.
You’ll need to demonstrate:
• Experience of creating bespoke development programmes based on an understanding of needs, sometimes developing and delivering workshops themselves.
• Outstanding interpersonal, relationship building, coaching and mentoring skills and the ability to deploy them in with first time founders and serial entrepreneurs even when things aren’t going well
• The ability to make sense of complex or ambiguous situations, connect different pieces of information and turn those insights into clear priorities, actions and opportunities.
• Experience of scouting for leading edge startups based on specific briefs – and building relationships with those startups to understand and ‘sell’ their fit with Geovation.
• An experimental and continuous improvement mindset, willing to try things out with the aim of learning and proving / disproving a hypothesis.
